arguments.lyrics:
[Intro - 4 bars, instrumental, no vocals, no count-in]

[Verse 1 - 4 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Here is an apple.
Apple, apple!
I see an apple.

[Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Verse 2 - 4 bars, sung, no instrumental gap]
Banana, banana!
Here is a banana.
Banana, banana!
I see a banana.

[Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Bridge - 4 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Can you say apple?
Banana, banana!
Can you say banana?

[Final Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Outro - 2 bars, sung]
Apple, banana!
Bye-bye, bye-bye!

[End - one final chord, stop]
arguments.style: Preserve the source song melody, original tempo, warm boy-like lead voice and clear English fruit words. Add a more defined playful dance pulse: punchy but gentle kick, crisp clap backbeat, springy syncopated bass and short rhythmic accents. Make the existing chorus bounce and its word accents hit the beat, without rushing the words. Keep the source song character, no new melody or genre switch. Tight continuous sung sections, no instrumental break, concise natural ending.
arguments.negative_style: long instrumental break, long intro, changed melody, abrupt cutoff, operatic vocals, exaggerated pitch shifting, unintelligible words
